LanguageData.NoOvereating.EnabledTip: Pawns eat only as many whole pieces of food as fit in their stomach. When off, eating works exactly like vanilla: the last partial piece is eaten and its overflow wasted.
LanguageData.NoOvereating.DebugLoggingTip: Log every adjusted pickup and meal to the game log with full numbers: pawn, food need, nutrition per piece, pieces taken vs vanilla. For verifying behavior and bug reports.
